title: scout on haiku
goal: The scout is ~78% of init cost ($0.12-0.15 of $0.17/run on the fixtures, 8-56 turns on inseer-frontend). Move it to haiku and cut its turns without losing context quality versus the sonnet reference (p19 baseline traces, inseer-frontend context), so init gets cheaper and the navigator does not get worse.

phases.title: Scout profile and quality measure ($0): from the p19 traces and a real inseer-frontend scout trace, break down scout turns, tool calls and tokens per activity (context tree, reads, per-level writes); add deterministic context graders to the init cases (modules covered vs truth, planted conventions present in conventions.md, index lists every module file) and score the sonnet reference with them.

Scout model set by config only: agents/scout.md no longer hard-codes sonnet, skills.init.scout model/effort reaches the Agent call reliably; test proves the setting applies; no behaviour change on sonnet.
Haiku scout as-is: five init cases x3 with scout on haiku vs the sonnet reference (case score, context graders, scout cost and turns); log the main gaps.

Fix haiku's main gap with the smallest generic change to the scout prompt or the context commands (and cut redundant scout turns found in the profile); rerun the five cases x3: context graders within tolerance of sonnet at lower cost.

Large-repo check: haiku scout on inseer-frontend writing to a separate dir (backup .local-docs/context and the current .ambicode/context untouched); compare turns, cost and coverage with the sonnet context; this context is the input for the navigator regression phase.
